items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: But one was done at Cosmos, the George Buck album. And Cosmo just had a way with a Dixieland band, Cosmo Metasms.

ctx.x: Well, I bought the album, and then Harvey made me return it. Harvey moved to me and said, get the other one. So I'll get the other one if you return that.

It's funny. It's the same band. We did two albums within three weeks with the same band. And really, the Yellow Dog Blues album had some, a couple of good, some of my best arrangements were on the Yellow Dog Blues album. And they got thrown into the trash can. The tapes got sidetracked. So they would have enough time to put Miss New Orleans on it because of the, the guy says, oh, it'll sell more records with that song on it. And I think one of the songs that they threw away was Sensation Rag, which I guess is the…

I've heard engineers tell the musicians that there wasn't enough separation. So they really isolated them like you're talking about. Did you ever have any problems with that on the audience? Where you couldn't hear the other members of the band?
